coordinate_metric: Derivative RGB->RGB in external Linear Rec.2020; not a perceptual metric
algorithm: Central differences at h and h/2, h=.002*max(abs RGB,0.18). Jacobi SVD via J^T J. Step disagreement >5% is unreliable; no absence-of-fold proof from finite sampling.
inspector: Append-only modes 11–15 probe one configured Volume family on Source RGB; full multi-region authored settings use this offline harness. Red=fold/collapse, magenta=unreliable differential. It does not inspect an arbitrary upstream Volume node automatically.
